To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
automation should provide continual feedback, continual interaction, and be designed to handle the worst situations.

(a) automation is not the problem; (b) the problem is the inappropriate design of automation; (c) the problem is inadequate feedback and inadequate interaction; (d) the solution is to make the automation more or less intelligent than it currently is; and (e) the solution is a more compliant and flexible design.
automation can be designed in such a way that it can reduce the probability of error and increase the probability of recovery from errors that do occur.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach to automation design that will allow for the appropriate use of automation in the control of complex dynamic systems.
the development of intelligent, flexible, and adaptive systems for the management of complex, high risk, and high consequence processes.
the development of a theory of human error, a theory of human-machine interaction and a theory of the design of human-computer interfaces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the problem with automation is not the automation itself but the inappropriate design of the feedback and interaction between automation and the operators.
The problem with automation is not over-automation, but rather under-automation.
the problem is inappropriate automation, not over-automation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that there is a way to reduce error through intelligent design.
the problem is the inappropriate feedback and interaction that occurs with current automation systems.
the problem is inappropriate design, not over-automation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the problem is one of design, not of automation per se.
the problem with automation is not over-automation, it is under-automation.
we should design for error and not against error.
